normal.notes: Internet data now shows your plan allowance and any extra data you've bought as two separate figures, so you can see which one a session is drawing on. Overhand always uses your plan data first — extra data waits until the plan runs out, and never expires. Please update.

beta.notes: Two-pot internet-data meter (plan vs extra) with a 'Used first' badge on whichever pot a session draws from.
